paper_title: Axion dark matter: strings and their cores
notes: This is a theoretical/numerical cosmology paper on axion string network evolution and axion production efficiency. It predicts a value of f_a = 3.3e11 GeV and m_a = 18 ueV from simulations, but this is a cosmological prediction of the axion mass/decay constant, not an experimental exclusion limit or sensitivity projection on a coupling. No exclusion curve or coupling constraint is presented, so no data points can be extracted as an experimental limit. | Coupling from pre-classifier (AxionMass, conf=0.90)
